comment:
* A listener transport object which can run listener operations on an executor.
 *
 * @param <TListener> listener type

methods.name: TListener getListener()
methods.comment:
* Should return a valid listener until {@link #unregister()} is invoked, and must return
     * null after that. Recommended (but not required) that this is implemented via a volatile
     * variable.

methods.name: void unregister()
methods.comment: * Must be implemented so that {@link #getListener()} returns null after this is invoked.

methods.name: void execute(Executor executor, Consumer<TListener> operation)
methods.comment: * Executes the given operation for the listener.
